stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Each neighbor gives an opinion about the new bench.
items.sentenceZh: 每位邻居都对新长椅发表意见。
items.scene: Exactly three adult neighbors examine two bench models at a community table. Each person expresses a different opinion through distinct calm gestures: one favors the curved bench, one favors the straight bench and one considers both. No voting, conflict or text.
items.altText: 三位邻居面对两种长椅模型，用不同手势表达各自意见。

items.sentenceEn: The designer gives credit to the carpenter who built the model.
items.sentenceZh: 设计师把制作模型的功劳归给木匠。
items.scene: At a project presentation, an adult designer stands beside a finished wooden pavilion model and openly gestures toward the adult carpenter who built it. The audience turns and applauds the carpenter, clearly showing recognition and credit without awards or text.
items.altText: 设计师在模型旁指向制作它的木匠，听众转向木匠鼓掌致意。

items.sentenceEn: This central pin is critical to the bridge model.
items.sentenceZh: 这枚中央连接销对桥梁模型至关重要。
items.scene: An adult engineer points to one small central locking pin joining two major halves of a bridge model. A nearby demonstration model without the pin visibly sags, while the complete model stays stable, showing that the component is critical.
items.altText: 工程师指出连接桥梁两半的中央销钉，缺少销钉的对比模型明显下垂。

items.sentenceEn: A reading chair stands in the corner of the room.
items.sentenceZh: 房间角落里放着一把阅读椅。
items.scene: Two walls meet at a clearly visible right-angle corner in a quiet room. A single reading chair, floor lamp and small stack of blank-covered books fit neatly into that corner, with open floor space around them emphasizing the location.
items.altText: 两面墙形成清晰直角，一把阅读椅和落地灯放在房间角落。

items.sentenceEn: She is concerned about the yellow leaves.
items.sentenceZh: 她很担心这些发黄的叶子。
items.scene: An adult gardener kneels beside one potted citrus tree with several yellow curling leaves. She gently checks the soil and examines a leaf with a clearly concerned, caring expression while healthy plants nearby provide comparison.
items.altText: 园丁查看柑橘树的黄叶和土壤，脸上露出关切神情。

items.sentenceEn: The old picnic basket helps her recall a childhood summer.
items.sentenceZh: 旧野餐篮让她回想起童年的夏天。
items.scene: An older adult opens an old picnic basket and smiles in recognition. Behind her, a soft translucent memory vignette shows the same basket beside a younger child and family picnic long ago, clearly separating present recall from the remembered scene.
items.altText: 老人打开旧野餐篮，身后淡淡浮现童年家庭野餐的回忆画面。

items.sentenceEn: The team compares three versions of the folding chair.
items.sentenceZh: 团队比较折叠椅的三个版本。
items.scene: Exactly three versions of the same folding chair stand side by side: a rough wooden prototype, an improved metal prototype and a refined final version. Two adult designers compare their shared shape and visible differences.
items.altText: 同一折叠椅的粗糙木制、改进金属和精致成品三个版本并排展示。

items.sentenceEn: He stares at the tiny clockwork bird.
items.sentenceZh: 他目不转睛地盯着那只微型机械鸟。
items.scene: In a museum display, one adult visitor leans slightly forward and stares intently at a tiny moving clockwork bird under glass. His eyes remain fixed on the object while nearby visitors glance elsewhere, making the sustained gaze unmistakable.
items.altText: 博物馆参观者身体微微前倾，双眼持续盯着玻璃罩内的机械鸟。

items.sentenceEn: The crew checks every safety measure before work.
items.sentenceZh: 施工队在开工前检查所有安全措施。
items.scene: Before beginning roof maintenance, three adult workers check fitted helmets, secured harness lines, stable guardrails and a closed ladder gate. Tools remain organized and no one is near an exposed edge, emphasizing safety preparation.
items.altText: 屋顶施工前，工人检查头盔、安全绳、护栏和梯口门。

items.sentenceEn: The layered filter is effective at cleaning muddy water.
items.sentenceZh: 分层过滤器能有效净化浑水。
items.scene: An adult educator pours muddy water into the top of a transparent layered filter containing gravel, sand and charcoal. Clearly clean water emerges into a glass below, with muddy input and clear output visible at the same time.
items.altText: 浑水经过透明的砾石、沙和木炭分层过滤器后流出清水。

items.sentenceEn: The neighborhood gathers in its shared street.
items.sentenceZh: 社区居民聚集在共用街道上。
items.scene: A connected residential neighborhood centers on one tree-lined shared street with homes, a small corner shop, a pocket park and a bus stop. Adult residents greet neighbors, tend a garden and walk together, showing a local community rather than a whole city.
items.altText: 住宅、街角小店、口袋公园和公交站围绕一条居民共同使用的街道。

items.meaningZh: 最初的；原始的；有创意的
items.sentenceEn: Her original bridge design uses a woven spiral.
items.sentenceZh: 她的原创桥梁设计采用编织螺旋结构。
items.scene: An adult designer presents one inventive pedestrian-bridge model made from an unusual woven spiral structure. Several conventional straight bridge models sit behind, while colleagues lean closer with impressed expressions, emphasizing originality.
items.altText: 设计师展示采用编织螺旋结构的独特人行桥模型，后方是普通直桥模型。

items.sentenceEn: A troop of baboons crosses the grassland.
items.sentenceZh: 一群狒狒穿过草原。
items.scene: A cohesive troop of seven baboons moves together across open grassland: adults lead and watch the surroundings while younger animals remain safely in the middle. Their coordinated group movement communicates a troop without military content.
items.altText: 七只狒狒组成紧密群体穿过草原，成年个体在外围照看幼崽。

items.sentenceEn: Selling bread at the market provides her income.
items.sentenceZh: 在市场卖面包为她带来收入。
items.scene: At a market stall, an adult baker hands bread to customers and receives plain coins without currency symbols. She places the earnings into a small cash box beside emptying bread baskets, showing money received through work as income.
items.altText: 面包师在市场出售面包，把顾客支付的无标志硬币放入钱箱。

items.sentenceEn: The farmer delivers the vegetables directly to the chef.
items.sentenceZh: 农民把蔬菜直接交给厨师。
items.scene: At a restaurant back door, one adult farmer hands a crate of vegetables directly into an adult chef's hands. The farm truck stands immediately behind the farmer and the kitchen immediately behind the chef, with no warehouse, shop or intermediary.
items.altText: 农民在餐馆后门把一箱蔬菜直接交到厨师手中。

items.sentenceEn: His ankle hurts after the long hike.
items.sentenceZh: 长途徒步后他的脚踝疼痛。
items.scene: At a safe trail rest area, an adult hiker sits comfortably and supports a mildly sore ankle while a companion wraps a cold pack in cloth and helps elevate the foot. His expression shows manageable pain without swelling, wounds or emergency distress.
items.altText: 徒步者坐着托住疼痛脚踝，同伴用布包冷敷并垫高他的脚。

items.sentenceEn: The wetland supports three frog species.
items.sentenceZh: 这片湿地生活着三种蛙类。
items.scene: Exactly three distinct frog species rest on separate natural perches in one wetland: a green tree frog with toe pads, a spotted brown frog near water and a small red-and-black frog on a leaf. An adult biologist observes without touching them.
items.altText: 湿地中三种外形和花纹明显不同的青蛙分别停在自然栖息处。

items.sentenceEn: When the rain begins, they immediately cover the hay.
items.sentenceZh: 雨一开始，他们立刻盖住干草。
items.scene: The first large raindrops begin to fall at a farm, and exactly two adults instantly pull a waterproof sheet over stacked dry hay. One side is already covered while the exposed side is being covered in the same moment, emphasizing immediate response.
items.altText: 第一批雨滴落下时，两名农民立刻把防水布拉到干草堆上。

items.sentenceEn: The ranger follows the animal tracks through the snow.
items.sentenceZh: 护林员沿着雪地里的动物足迹前进。
items.scene: A continuous line of clear paw tracks crosses fresh snow from the foreground into a pine forest. An adult ranger kneels to inspect one print and then looks along the trail, while the animal itself remains unseen.
items.altText: 清晰爪印从前景延伸进松林，护林员跪下检查其中一个足迹。

items.sentenceEn: The class begins with three basic hand tools.
items.sentenceZh: 课程从三种基本手工具开始。
items.scene: An adult instructor teaches a beginner using exactly three fundamental hand tools arranged separately on a workbench: one hammer, one flat screwdriver and one adjustable wrench. A simple practice board and attentive learner show an introductory basic lesson.
items.altText: 入门课程的工作台上只摆着锤子、平口螺丝刀和活动扳手三种基本工具。
